data.sub: UP mein ab bina 2 gawahon ke hi ho sakegi zameen registry

chat.say: Sharma ji ko gawah banane ki tension khatam!
Matlab ab registry ekdum aaram se ho jayegi?

data.asar: Ab registry office mein gawahon ke nakhre nahi.
data.caption:
UP walon ke liye property khareedna aur bechna ab pehle se kaafi aasan ho gaya hai!

🏠 UP mein zameen ki registry ke niyam hue aasan
✍️ Ab registry ke dauran do gawahon ki zaroorat nahi padegi
⚡ Chutki bajate hi poora hoga bainama

Ab padosi Sharma ji ke pair nahi padne padenge sign karwane ke liye.

Save kar lo ye post, zameen ya plot lete waqt kaam aayegi!
